text: Exam 2 covers chapters 3 and 4: angles in degrees and radians, arc length and sector area, exact values of the six trigonometric functions, the unit circle, graphs of sine and cosine, amplitude, period and phase shift, and inverse trigonometric functions.

Answer exactly unless the problem says to round. Rationalize denominators and keep π in radian answers. A graphing calculator is allowed for the problems that ask you to find an angle to the nearest degree.
